hero.name: PHUA ZAI WEI
hero.introSuffix: — a fullstack developer crafting fast, beautiful web experiences from pixel to deployment.

projects.title: KetoAgent
projects.subtitle: Lightweight Dockerized AI Agent
bullets: Developed an autonomous AI agent that uses 20x less context than OpenClaw (6k vs 120k).
Built a plugin-style tool framework with 9 built-in tools (file read/write/list, shell, grep, search_files, apply_patch, web search/fetch) that the agent invokes autonomously to complete tasks.
Integrated Telegram Bot API for bidirectional messaging.
Implemented context management with token budget tracking, adaptive message trimming, LLM-based compaction, large-result compression and safety limits (20 iterations, 5 min runtime cap).

projects.title: ElasticLLM
projects.subtitle: LLM API Proxy
bullets: Built an OpenAI-compatible API gateway that routes requests across multiple LLM providers (Groq, Gemini) and multiple models into a single API endpoint.
Distribute requests across multiple models according to weights token limits.
Implemented retry and failover cycling.
Built a real-time admin dashboard to monitor token usage and other metrics.
Added a chatbot with model selection and SSE streaming for testing completions.

projects.title: NekoTag
projects.subtitle: AI-Enabled E-Commerce Platform
bullets: Serverless Stack: React frontend deployed on Firebase, with a Node.js backend on AWS Lambda and Firestore database.
Integrations: Secure user login via Google OAuth and transactional payment processing via Stripe Sandbox.
AI Admin Agent: Administrative chatbot leveraging Gemini API and Model Context Protocol (MCP) for context-aware database workflows.
Automated DevOps: GitHub Actions pipeline automating linting, unit testing, and multi-cloud deployment on code push.

projects.title: Password Manager & 2FA Authenticator
projects.subtitle: Android Flutter App
bullets: Encrypted passwords stored in AWS DynamoDB with field-level encryption.
TOTP-based 2FA code generation with secrets also stored in DynamoDB.
Both passwords and 2FA codes cached locally for offline access.
